notes: Registration input, not a run input: Kalshi's public trade API v2 (no credential, the existing kalshi pack, ADR-0075) for the six crypto series probed 2026-10-06: KXBTC and KXETH (hourly range), KXBTCD and KXETHD (hourly above/below), KXBTC15M and KXETH15M (15-minute up/down). All settle on the CF Benchmarks Real Time Index, the average of its 60 prices in the last minute. Streams used: markets (strikes, result, close_time; ~190 markets per hourly event, 1000 a page), fee_schedules (fee_type and multiplier per series, read from the venue, never typed) and orderbooks (one book per OPEN market). statuses is ['settled']: history is settled markets only, so every row is final; the live API serves them back to about the 2026-08-07 historical cutoff (probe: KXETH15M's oldest close was 2026-07-31), and earlier markets wait on the PROPOSED kalshi /historical ADR (decision-log). The orderbooks stream lists open markets whatever statuses says, so the live recorder is the SAME source: acquire --mode live --stream orderbooks on a cadence (checkpoints are keyed per source, stream and mode; a pass is one request per open market, about 300 open markets each for KXBTC and KXBTCD at the probe). pace_s 0.25 and retries 6 are slower and more patient than the pack defaults: a failed pull commits nothing, so a long walk should ride out 429s. Candles are a separate source (source-kalshi-crypto-candles.json). Register: python -m dskit.onboarding register-source kalshi-crypto --catalog-source kalshi-crypto --connector kalshi --config @configs/source-kalshi-crypto.json --activate --root <store root>.
